biggest_catch: Florida residents only; bonus credits up to 95 days after account opening; offer cannot be combined with any other checking bonus offers.
catches: Up to $50 bonus to both the current Seacoast customer who refers and the new customer who completes qualifying activities.
Referring customers may earn bonuses for each new relationship opened, up to ten referrals ($500 value) per calendar year.
Offer valid 12/15/2025–12/31/2026. Valid for Florida residents only; must be 18+.
New customer earns $25 for qualifying direct deposit(s) and/or $25 for 15 debit card purchases (excludes ATMs) in the first 90 days; $50 minimum opening balance.
Bonus credited within 95 days of opening if requirements are met; account must remain open and in good standing.
Bonuses are considered interest and may be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
All existing Seacoast Bank customers (including accounts closed within the last 12 months) and associates are not eligible.
